page.overview:
Who is Electric Sky?

Electric Sky is a female background unicorn pony who first appears in the season five episode The Cutie Re-Mark - Part 1. She has a light yellow coat, two-tone blue mane and tail, blue eyes, and a cutie mark of three light bulbs. She first appeared in merchandise.

In the series, Electric Sky shares her design with Amethyst Star, Banana Fluff, Diamond Mint, Lemony Gem, Lyra Heartstrings, Silver Spanner from the back, "Sugarberry", "Orchid Dew", "Spring Fresh", S01E26 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #4, "Cold Front", "Fly Wishes", S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #1, S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #3, S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #9, S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #12, "Sea Spray", "Monochrome Sunset", "Lilac Notes", "Heather Harp", "Nachtmusik", S05E24 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #1, "Minty Bubblegum", and S06E12 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #2, her mane and tail style with Rose, Silverspeed, unicorn Red Gala, "Sunset Bliss", and S04E24 Unnamed Earth Mare #6, her tail style with Royal Ribbon, "Sweet Dreams", "Strawberry Lime", "Midwinter Grace", and S02E26 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #11, and her cutie mark object with "Tornado Bolt" sometimes.

In merchandise, she shares her design with Beachberry, Cinnamon Breeze, Firecracker Burst, Lovestruck, Lucky Swirl, Pick-a-Lily, Moon Dancer, Pudding Pie, Rainbow Wishes, Sweetcream Scoops, Twilight Sparkle, Waterfire, S02E02 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #1, and S02E02 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #2 and her tail style with Photo Finish.

Electric Sky, as well as Magnet Bolt, Cherry Spices, "Rivet", and Barber Groomsby, was to appear in Boast Busters.
